notes.title: Storm's Harvest 1.0.8 Halloweeen Update
notes.notes:
We've been hard at work since launch responding to your feedback and have made several improvement's to Storm's Harvest. We hope that this solves most of the issues players have been having. 

Gameplay:

Overall adjustments to hitboxes/ hurtboxes
Wand is no longer stopped by pumpkins or webs
Time window Wendy can be scared back to her perch increased
Custom controls now save between sessions
Added an extra "moves tutorial" screen before the first night


Graphical:

Added extra cues for Wendy stealing a pumpkin
Changed hearts to green when supercharged
Visual changes to Wendy's "Change Map" effect
Button for changing bezel can now be pressed to flip through rather than just left and right
Added extra leaves to the highscore screen


Happy Halloween!
GGS
